business.title: SpaceX’s Spectrum Purchase Exposes Risks for Big Telecom Stocks
business.description: Telecom stocks have long been considered a relatively safe bet for investors, offering predictable growth, limited downside and healthy dividends. But a combination of competition from SpaceX and rising Treasury yields is threatening to upend that equation.

business.title: Truecaller India Rival Seeks $1 Billion Valuation in New Funding
business.description: Automated call screening app Equal AI is seeking fresh fundraising that could propel it into the league of unicorns, according to its founder, as the startup aims to take on Truecaller.

business.title: Deutsche Bank Sees 'Promising' Signs in Limited Selloff
business.description: Henry Allen, macro strategist at Deutsche Bank Research, discusses market moves as a selloff in the artificial intelligence trade gathered speed. "If it was a concern, we'd be seeing broader stock market see bigger falls," he tells Bloomberg Television. "The fact that we haven't seen that spread to Europe, for instance, we haven't seen that contagion, that slowdown elsewhere, I think is a promising sign," Allen adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

business.title: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’
business.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.

devices.title: Apple Now Inviting Media to October 28 'Launch Experience'
devices.description: Apple has begun inviting selected members of the media to a product launch experience in Los Angeles on Wednesday, October 28, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. In a post on X, Gurman described the gathering as an "all-day product launch experience" for touchscreen MacBooks, a new iPad mini, and Macs equipped with M6 chips. previously reported that Apple would introduce the devices "on or around" Tuesday, October 27, with an online video presentation and a hands-on experience for the media.

devices.title: Touchscreen MacBook Pro and more launching at Apple event on Oct 28
devices.description: We’ve long been awaiting the launch of the first touchscreen and OLED MacBook Pro, and a new report says that the official launch will take place at an Apple event on October 28. It says that Apple has begun sending invites to selected media representatives. The same event will include the OLED iPad mini as well as an M6 original design MacBook Pro and iMac … more…

ai.description: Ted Mortonson, managing director of technology at Baird, expects that a sharp move lower in the artificial intelligence trade will happen “real quick” if the market moves from fear to a panic phase. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: AI Demand Keeps T. Rowe Price CIO Optimistic on Trade
ai.description: Sebastien Page, co-head of global investments and CIO at T. Rowe Price, explains why he “fundamentally” remains optimistic on the artificial intelligence trade over the next 6-12 months. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
